items.exampleEn: The old wooden table feels rough.
items.exampleZh: 那張舊木桌摸起來很粗糙。

items.exampleEn: We saw a distant ship on the sea.
items.exampleZh: 我們看見海上一艘遙遠的船。

items.exampleEn: It is remarkable that the old tree is still alive.
items.exampleZh: 那棵老樹居然還活著，真是了不起。

items.exampleEn: Try to give accurate answers on the form.
items.exampleZh: 填表時盡量給出準確的答案。

items.exampleEn: The instructions were long and complicated.
Try to speak naturally, as if you're at home.
items.exampleZh: 試著自然地說話，就像在家裡一樣。

items.exampleEn: Our friendship is based on mutual respect.
items.exampleZh: 我們的友誼建立在相互尊重之上。

items.sentenceEn: The map is not very accurate.

items.audioEn: The ship goes to the distant island only twice a year, in spring and in fall.
items.audioZh: 那艘船一年只開往那座遙遠的小島兩次，春天和秋天各一次。
items.questionZh: 那艘船一年去小島幾次？
options: Once in spring and once in fall

items.sentenceEn: The story is complicated, but it's worth reading.
items.sentenceZh: 這個故事很複雜，但值得一讀。
我們有一個共同的朋友。

items.stemEn: My hands became ____ after a week of farm work.
items.stemZh: 做了一星期的農活後，我的手變得很粗糙。

items.stemEn: Our new teacher made a ____ change: in one year, the whole class came to love reading.
items.stemZh: 我們的新老師帶來了非凡的改變：一年之內，全班都愛上了閱讀。

items.passageEn: My grandparents live in a distant village in the mountains. The road there is rough, so the trip takes four hours. Last summer, I stayed with them for a month. It took me a few days to adapt to life without the internet. Life there was not complicated at all. People grew their own food, and their water came from a mountain stream, so it was naturally clean. My grandpa has a remarkable skill: his guesses about the weather are always accurate. He just looks at the sky. The people in the village have mutual respect: when one family needs help, everyone comes. Similarly, when someone has good news, the whole village celebrates.
items.passageZh: 我的爺爺奶奶住在山裡一個遙遠的村子。去那裡的路很崎嶇，所以路程要四個小時。去年夏天，我在他們家住了一個月。我花了幾天才適應沒有網路的生活。那裡的生活一點也不複雜。人們自己種食物，他們的水來自山上的溪流，天然就很乾淨。我爺爺有一項非凡的本領：他對天氣的猜測總是很準確。他只要看看天空就知道。村裡的人互相尊重：一家需要幫忙時，大家都會來。同樣地，有人有好消息時，全村都會一起慶祝。

questions.questionZh: 為什麼到村子要花四個小時？
options: 因為中途要換好幾次車

questions.questionZh: 爺爺有什麼特別的本領？
options: 只要看天空就能準確猜出天氣

items.promptZh: 這台機器用起來太複雜了。
referenceEn: This machine is too complicated to use.
Using this machine is too complicated.
rubricZh: complicated 表示「複雜的」，例如 too complicated to… 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 我們聽得到遠處傳來的雷聲。
referenceEn: We heard the sound of distant thunder.
rubricZh: 用 distant 表示「遠方的」（例如 distant thunder）
時態可用 can hear、could hear、heard 等
